stories.title: Labour cabinet stands down at neighbouring Denbighshire council, blaming Plaid Cymru
stories.summary: The Labour leader of Denbighshire County Council and his Labour cabinet members have resigned with immediate effect, a week after Plaid Cymru walked out of the coalition that had run the authority for four years. stories.title: Delays on A55 and M56 eastbound as bank holiday getaway begins
stories.summary: Road closures are in place between Daresbury and Walton Golf Club in Cheshire until Sunday for the Creamfields festival. Queueing traffic has been reported on the approach, with congestion running back to the A56 Chester Road. stories.title: Police warn riders over missing number plates after north Flintshire seizure
stories.summary: A scooter has been seized by North Wales Police officers covering north Flintshire, who used the case to warn riders about hiding or removing registration plates. stories.title: North Wales scientists race to measure wildfire damage to UK soils
stories.summary: Scientists at Bangor University are measuring how much damage this summer’s wildfires have done to soils in north Wales, starting with burnt ground near Conwy and Harlech. stories.title: North Wales police commissioner backs devolution but warns against Cardiff pull
stories.summary: The Police and Crime Commissioner for North Wales has said any transfer of policing powers from Westminster to Cardiff must not leave the north short of money or a say in how its force is run.
